label_provenance.method: Labels authored by reading the committed real foreign corpus (click 8.1.7 slice). Anchor terms verified by grep over the slice: 'progressbar'/'secho' occur only in clickcode/termui.py; 'HelpFormatter' only in clickcode/formatting.py; 'MissingParameter' only in clickcode/exceptions.py; 'prompt'/'UsageError' are cross-cutting and occur in BOTH namespaces (the contamination probes). required_sources are chunk-bearing files the harness resolves to concrete leaves via a scoped #36 search; a file-level hit is credited only when a chunk from that file is retained.

queries.rationale: 'prompt' is cross-cutting and also present in clickdocs; scoped to clickcode it must retain clickcode evidence (termui.py prompt/confirm/hidden-input helpers) and leak ZERO clickdocs chunks.
'progressbar' is a rare decisive term occurring only in clickcode/termui.py.
Exact symbol reference; HelpFormatter is defined only in clickcode/formatting.py.
current_only must return the current claim tmo_v2 (60s) and EXCLUDE the superseded tmo_v1 (30s), pool-independently.
Historical intent must make the superseded tmo_v1 RETRIEVABLE (the current-vs-historical duality: the version is not deleted, only not current).
A synthesis query drawing on error-reporting evidence across exceptions.py and termui.py; exercises bounded packet cost with multi-source evidence.

The reverse contamination direction: 'prompt'/'confirmation' are cross-cutting (also in clickcode); scoped to clickdocs it must retain docs evidence (options.rst prompting) and leak ZERO clickcode chunks.

thresholds.bounded_context_cost: every scale: packet token_budget.used <= budget AND excerpt_count <= max_excerpts AND used does not grow with leaf count
thresholds.current_vs_historical: every temporal query honored (current_only excludes stale; historical retrieves it)
thresholds.navigation_sublinear: nodes_examined/leaf_count strictly decreases across >=2 orders of magnitude; p50 not constant; log-shaped
thresholds.hierarchy_path_recall_note: fast beam may be < 1000000; guaranteed (explore-all) and packet (fallback) must be 1000000
